data.title: JPMorgan’s Bitcoin and Crypto-Linked Holdings Approach $1 Billion
data.description: The bank’s Q3 13F shows roughly $981 million across Bitcoin ETFs, Strategy and Coinbase—likely over $1 billion counting Robinhood and miners.
